description: NaMg₆LaO₈ is beta Polonium-derived structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/mmm space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent LaO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (2.26 Å) and two longer (2.44 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are two shorter (2.05 Å) and four longer (2.26 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are two shorter (2.06 Å) and four longer (2.26 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. In the third Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-1°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.44 Å. La is bonded to six O atoms to form LaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent LaO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (2.26 Å) and two longer (2.46 Å) La-O bond lengths. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Mg and one La atom to form OLaMg₅ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent OLaMg₅ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-1°. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na and five Mg atoms to form ONaMg₅ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ONaMg₅ octahedra and edges with twelve OLaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Mg, and two equivalent La atoms to form ONa₂La₂Mg₂ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂La₂Mg₂ octahedra and edges with twelve OLaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂La₂Mg₂ octahedra and edges with twelve OLaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Mg, and two equivalent La atoms to form ONa₂La₂Mg₂ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₆ octahedra and edges with twelve OLaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. Both O-Mg bond lengths are 2.44 Å.
